Task 3
   Questions 11-15

   Read the text below.
   For questions 11-15, write one or two words, or a number.
   Write your answers on the lines below the text.
   There is an example at the beginning (0).


                                           Ariel, the mermaid

   I grew up on the coast and the sea has always fascinated me. Although most of my friends were
   too scared to go swimming after watching The Shark, the film Splash played a huge part in my
   childhood and I spent lots of time under water. And then I grew up. I thought the big city lifestyle
   was what I wanted. At 16 I moved to London. Unfortunately I didn’t have many friends or family
   there although I was born there. I was lonely, so I returned home to St Ives and I decided to stay.
   I started working as a fitness instructor but I soon quit. I enjoyed watching the waves and the sea
   and when one evening I saw the most gorgeous sunset, I realised that was where I was meant to
   be. It hit me – I could be a mermaid.
   I bought a mermaid tail and posted on Instagram that people might see a mermaid in St Ives, and
   then I slipped into the water and swam around the harbour. Initially I thought I’d hop into the sea
   on weekends, but now I swim every day. I might even turn this hobby into a profession. Now, five
   years later, I know leaving London was a life-saving decision.
   I change into my tail and swim out to sea before I appear swimming towards the beach. I use
   social media to announce where and when I will be appearing so children and parents can talk to
   me and take photos.
   The doctors and nurses at the hospital, where I work as a receptionist, are incredibly supportive.
   They call me Ariel like in that favourite children’s movie, because they know how much swimming
   means to me.


    0 Nickname:                                 Ariel
   11 Age:                             ___
   12 Birthplace:                      ___
   13 Present job:                     ___
   14 Previous job:                    ___
   15 Inspiring movie:                 ___




     ENG B IK-1 D-S054

                                                     8

   things. Try to walk or bike more but also eat less meat because raising livestock produces large
   amounts of greenhouse gases.

   and cleaning products that aren’t tested on animals. Testing is a cruel process and you can end it
   for good (20) ___. It will make a small difference to you but a world of difference to the animals
   involved.
